record.section: 04.matter Explicit 3-element branch set with transitive S_3 permutation action
record.notes: Truthful combinatorial owner: explicit 3-element branch set with transitive S_3 permutation action. Formalizes the finite combinatorial scaffold of three octonionic branches without claiming an internal derivation of the full Cayley-Dickson multiplication algebra or minimal left ideals (branch_label_s3_scaffold).

question.statement: Does the exact selected lower-order RREF representative of the perpendicular H=a*x, J=b*y branch at h=1 admit any fifth-amplitude extension, after allowing arbitrary fifth-degree corrections to the Lorentz links and coframe?

The lower-order fields are exactly the mixed-quartic and asymmetric-quartic RREF representatives pinned by the cited checkers, with their remaining homogeneous modes set to zero.
The fifth-order Lorentz exponential includes all terms through degree five.

Fintype.card D0.Algebra.Sedenions.OctonionBranch = 3 ∧
  (∀ (x y : D0.Algebra.Sedenions.OctonionBranch),
      ∃ f,
        (f = id ∨
            f = D0.Algebra.Sedenions.s3_cycle ∨
              f = D0.Algebra.Sedenions.s3_cycle ∘ D0.Algebra.Sedenions.s3_cycle ∨
                f = D0.Algebra.Sedenions.s3_swap ∨
                  f = D0.Algebra.Sedenions.s3_swap ∘ D0.Algebra.Sedenions.s3_cycle ∨
                    f = D0.Algebra.Sedenions.s3_cycle ∘ D0.Algebra.Sedenions.s3_swap) ∧
          f x = y) ∧
    D0.Algebra.Sedenions.leftProduct ≠ D0.Algebra.Sedenions.rightProduct

item.label: BOOK_06 §06.spectral metric-measure Hodge weight formula scaffold

record.notes: HONEST SCOPE: defines W(k,mu,prod_c)=mu^(1-k)*prod_c, proves the k=0 and k=1 endpoint identities, and records the 16 cell sectors. It does not prove uniqueness/canonicity of the formula across all grades or its reduction from the actual frozen refinement weights. Those stronger statements require separate theorems.
